title: Refined Fuels Dispatch Standing Basis — Route, Trigger and Hold Settings
content:
Dispatch works the refined fuels and propane routes from the settings the catalogue fixes for each programme under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts. Those settings decide how often a tank's route is run, at what gauge reading an automatic fill is scheduled and how full the truck leaves the tank, how much notice a called-in stop needs, the smallest load the truck will make, and whether the account may stand on seasonal hold and for how long.

## Settings by programme

| Programme | Route frequency | Automatic fill trigger, percent of gauge | Automatic fill-to, percent of gauge | Notice for a called-in stop, business days | Smallest delivery, gallons | Seasonal hold offered | Longest seasonal hold, calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | on request only | 0 | 0 | 3 | 150 | yes | 240 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | every 21 days | 30 | 80 | 2 | 200 | yes | 180 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | every 21 days | 30 | 80 | 2 | 200 | no | 0 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | every 21 days | 30 | 80 | 2 | 300 | no | 0 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | every 14 days | 25 | 90 | 1 | 500 | yes | 120 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | unattended site access | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | 0 |

## Reading the columns

The trigger and fill-to columns are gauge readings on the tank, not gallons. On the Keep-Full Automatic Delivery, Budget Payment Plan and Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Accounts the trigger stands at 30 percent and the fill-to at 80 percent; on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account the trigger stands at 25 percent and the fill-to at 90 percent. The Will-Call Propane Account and the Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account carry both figures at 0, since neither is worked on an automatic schedule: the first is run on request only and the second on unattended site access.

The notice column runs from 3 business days on the Will-Call Propane Account down to 1 business day on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account, with 2 business days on the three middle propane programmes and 0 on the Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account. The smallest delivery rises from 150 gallons on the Will-Call Propane Account through 200 and 300 gallons to 500 gallons on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account.

Seasonal hold is offered on the Will-Call Propane, Keep-Full Automatic Delivery and Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Accounts, at 240, 180 and 120 calendar days respectively. The Budget Payment Plan, Contract Gallon Pre-Buy and Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts do not carry it, and their hold maximum stands at 0.
